  backups_list            read     The backup files on this machine, newest first: org, when, size a
  down                    restart  Stop an org: stops and removes its container
  env ls                  read     The names of an org's custom environment variables
  env migrate             write    Move an org's secrets and custom variables out of org.env into fi
  env unset               restart  Remove one of an org's custom variables
  fw allow                write    Add entries to an org's egress allowlist
  fw deny                 write    Remove entries from an org's egress allowlist, exactly as written
  fw off                  write    Turn an org's egress firewall off: the org can reach anything unt
  fw on                   write    Turn an org's egress firewall on: only what its allowlist names c
  fw presets              read     The firewall's @presets and the hosts each one allows
